scope: Original P8-006 universal acceptance scope versus already registered study commitments

findings.where: tasks.json / P8-006 steps, acceptance, validations and dependencies
findings.finding: Requires no-op/body/API/config/batch and over-budget closure, attributable phase counts/time, full parity after closure and explicit incomplete status, old regressions, V07/V20 and P7-020/P8-001/P8-005 dependencies; does not itself specify the five-by-nine-by-thirty Cartesian population.

Original coverage includes 1k-100k, all named update classes, batch 1/10/100/1000 and fanout/fixed points. Sampling wording is in the query-profile paragraph, suggests at least 30 per stratum and at least 200 for formal tail-latency profiles, calls these design lower bounds that P0 may lock. It neither permits arbitrary one-sample release acceptance nor explicitly defines every update cell as N30. Correctness/source/compile failures block; insufficient evidence cannot automatically pass.

The exact 1500 population is the selected registered full-scale producer contract: five capacities times nine main stages times 30 plus five fanout groups times 30; five original repetition-zero shards followed by 145, aggregate requires all 150 and N30 per group. Current G8 and wide registrations retain this commitment; no post-hoc shrinking, removal of failed primaries, relabeling a partial run or cross-source pooling is authorized.

Task completion requires actual connected implementation, positive/negative and old regressions, configuration/documentation, recovery and target-SHA evidence; phase work must be attributable. A source-only change or passing component control is insufficient.

conclusion: No universal five-capacity x nine-stage x N30 Cartesian rule was found in the original P8-006 task/V07/V20 text. The current selected and registered studies do explicitly require their full 150/1500; this clarification changes none of those registrations and approves no reduced alternative population.
execution_boundary: Read-only exact Git text and line-scope analysis. No product, source CLI, study, task mutation, new acceptance gate or waiver.
